name: What's the difference between pre-move-in renovation and a standard home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between pre-move-in renovation and a standard home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The key difference lies in occupancy. Pre-move-in renovation occurs when the home is vacant, allowing for unobstructed work, faster timelines, and less daily disruption for the homeowner. Contractors have full access to the property, which can lead to more efficient project management and potentially lower labor costs due to reduced logistical challenges. A standard home renovation, performed while residents live in the property, often requires careful scheduling around daily routines, setting up temporary facilities, and managing dust and noise in an occupied space, which can extend timelines and increase complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pre-move-in renovation is done in a vacant home, allowing faster, less disruptive work. Standard renovation occurs in an occupied home, requiring more careful scheduling and managing daily disruptions.
